extracted_content.content: Facilities report evaluation and management (E/M) services provided in the emergency department using Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) codes 99281 - 99285 and Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) codes G0380 - G0384 in conjunction with an applicable revenue code. This policy outlines the criteria Humana plans use to determine the level of reimbursement for facility E/M services provided in the emergency department. This policy is based on principles for reporting emergency department E/M services established by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and on the code descriptions for CPT codes 99281 - 99285 and HCPCS codes G0380 - G0384.

For reimbursable services, Humana compares facility charges for E/M services provided in emergency departments to the criteria outlined in the guidelines below. When the criteria associated with the facility's billed emergency department E/M service code are not satisfied, Humana provides reimbursement at the emergency department E/M service code level for which the criteria in the following guidelines are satisfied but will not reimburse at a higher E/M service code than billed.

Humana recognizes condition code 45 and modifier KX, when submitted on a claim for a charge for a gender- specific service, as an indication that the service may be medically necessary, despite an apparent conflict between reported gender and the gender-specific service. extracted_content.content: The following policy outlines Humana's billing requirements and reimbursement for inpatient services after a determination that the inpatient level of care is not appropriate. For more information on Humana's coverage decisions for inpatient hospital services, see the Medicare Advantage Inpatient and Acute Care Hospital Services medical coverage policy available in the References section of this policy.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. As used in this policy, x represents any appropriate frequency code, which is the final digit of the type of bill (TOB) code. Claims for Inpatient Services When an Inpatient Admission Was Not Medically Necessary Humana's Medicare Advantage plans follow the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) guidelines for inpatient Part B re- billing. When an acute care hospital determines before discharge that the patient should not have been admitted as an inpatient, Humana will only accept services submitted on an appropriate outpatient TOB 13x or 85x claim; and will allow the provider to submit all codes that, for a normal outpatient situation, could be appropriate for that TOB; and requires condition code 44. An inpatient claim should not be submitted. When an acute care hospital or Humana determines after discharge that the patient should not have been admitted as an inpatient, Humana will only accept services submitted on an inpatient Part B TOB 12x claim. The billing should reflect the reasonable and necessary Part B services and provide the correct Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) and Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) codes when available. Report condition code W2 to indicate that this is a Part B claim and include "A/B Rebilling" in the treatment authorization field. For preadmission services in the 3-day payment window, a hospital may separately bill for services provided prior to an inpatient admission and should report "A/B Rebilling" in the treatment authorization field of the appropriate outpatient TOB 13x or 85x claim. Note: When a facility fails to obtain a required inpatient authorization or the authorization request is denied, the facility must bill emergency-related services provided before the inpatient admission separately from the inpatient services. For an inpatient admission that requires authorization, Humana will deny an inpatient claim that includes unauthorized inpatient services, including charges for preadmission emergency-related services. When billed on inpatient Part B claims or outpatient claims, some services may require specific authorization.

extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Overview
extracted_content.content: Facility billing guidelines for the UB-04 claim form, also known as the CMS-1450, and the 837 institutional electronic equivalent require providers to bill revenue codes to describe services rendered. Revenue codes are categorical and do not describe exact items, supplies and services provided during an inpatient admission. Humana may request an itemized bill for an inpatient facility claim to verify that billed revenue codes represent charges for appropriately billed items, supplies and services. Routine items, supplies and services already included in the primary inpatient room and board charge are not separately billable.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana sometimes reviews an itemized bill for an inpatient admission to determine whether supplies, items and services specified on the itemized bill are separately billable. To separately bill for items, supplies and services rendered during an inpatient hospital encounter, the provider must consistently follow its customary charging practices for all Medicare and non-Medicare patients, for all payers and health plans. The following supplies, items and services are typically not separately billable and, therefore, not separately payable from the general room and board charge or primary service charge. Please note that the examples given do not represent an exhaustive list.

All reusable items, supplies and equipment that are provided to all patients on a routine basis during an inpatient admission; this applies to all types of inpatient admissions, including an admission to a specific treatment area, such as a NICU or CCU, and applies to the admission of a patient who is receiving the same types of service as a patient in a specific treatment area. Examples of reusable items, supplies and equipment are cardiac monitors and durable medical equipment (DME) items used while inpatient.

In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana Medicaid plans review inpatient itemized bills with routine services according to applicable state Medicaid agency requirements.

Customary charging practices: A provider's common or established practice for classifying a particular item or service that is consistently followed for all patients and does not result in an inequitable apportionment of cost to the Medicare Program.

Room and board charge: Inpatient routine services in an inpatient facility generally are those services included by the provider in a daily service charge, which is sometimes referred to as the room and board charge. The room and board charge includes the room, dietary and nursing services, minor medical and surgical supplies, medical social services, psychiatric social services and the use of certain equipment and facilities for which a separate charge is not payable.

Routine: Inpatient routine services in an inpatient facility generally are those services included by the provider in a daily service charge, sometimes referred to as the room and board charge. Some examples of routine services include the room, dietary and nursing services, minor medical and surgical supplies, medical social services, psychiatric social services and the use of certain equipment and facilities for which a separate charge is generally not payable.

extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Overview
extracted_content.content: An itemized bill is a statement that lists all healthcare services provided to a patient. A statement that lists groups of services or items, such as those reported by revenue codes, is not considered to be an itemized bill because revenue codes are categorical and do not describe exact services and items provided. This policy outlines Humana's expectation that an itemized bill be made available to Humana upon request.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Specific immunoglobulin E (IgE) in-vitro allergy testing (CPT code 86003***, CPT code 86008****), up to 20 allergen specific antibodies per year, IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

In-vitro testing for total serum IgE (CPT code 82785*) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

The antigen leukocyte antibody test (e.g., ALCAT) (CPT code 83516) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for the following conditions:

Adverse effect of other drugs, medicaments, and biological substances

In-vitro testing of allergen specific IgG or non-specific IgG, IgA, IgM, and IgD in the evaluation of suspected allergy (CPT code 82784, CPT code 82787, CPT code 86001**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE. for the following conditions:

Adverse effect of other drugs, medicaments, and biological substances

Basophil activation flow cytometry testing (BAT) for measuring hypersensitivity to allergens (CPT code 88184*^, CPT code 88185*^) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

In-vitro allergen testing using bead-based epitope assays (e.g., VeriMAP Peanut Dx) (CPT code 0165U*^^, CPT code 0178U*^^) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

In-vitro testing of allergen non-specific IgE that does not identify a specific allergen using qualitative multi-allergen screen (CPT code 86005***) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Bacterial culture testing (CPT code 87081, CPT code 87070, CPT code 87071) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in cases of viral pharyngitis.

Amplification testing (CPT code 87651) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in cases of viral pharyngitis.

Rapid antigen diagnostic testing (RADT) (CPT code 87880) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following:

As a follow-up test to bacterial culture test (CPT code 87081, CPT code 87070, CPT code 87071) for a Streptococcal infection within the prior 14 days

Serological titer testing (CPT code 86060, CPT code 86215) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in patients with Streptococcus.

Direct probe testing (CPT code 87650) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE if amplification testing (CPT code 87651) for Streptococcus has been performed on the same date of service.

The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE in patients with Streptococcus or Enterococcus:

Tests that screen and identify multiple Streptococcal strains, using either immunoassay or nucleic acid-based assays, such as the Solana Strep Complete Assay and the Lyra Direct Strep Assay (CPT code 83789, CPT code 87430)

The quantification of any strain of Streptococcus using nucleic acid amplification, including polymerase chain reaction (PCR), (CPT code 87652) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals with a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or dementia, measurement of the following biomarkers IS REIMBURSABLE:

Amyloid beta peptides (CPT Code 82233, CPT code 82234, CPT code 0358U)

The ratio (CPT code 0459U) of total tau (t-tau) (CPT code 84394) to amyloid beta 1-42 (Aβ42) (CPT code 82234)

The ratio (CPT code 0445U) of phosphorylated tau 181 (p-tau181) (CPT code 84393) to Aβ42 (CPT code 82234)

The ratio of p-tau 217 (p-tau217) (CPT code 84393, CPT code 0479U) to Aβ42 (CPT code 82234)

When not ordered in conjunction with Aβ42 (CPT code 82234), measurement of the following biomarkers IS NOT REIMBURSABLE:

t-tau (CPT code 84394)

p-tau181 (CPT code 84393)

p-tau217 (CPT code 84393, CPT code 0479U)

For individuals with a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or dementia, measurement of other biomarkers (CPT code 83520, CPT code 83884, CPT code 0547U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

For individuals with a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or dementia, measurement of all other cerebral spinal fluid biomarkers (CPT code 0393U, CPT code 0443U, CPT code 0548U) or plasma biomarkers (CPT code 0479U, CPT code 0551U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of DISCERNTM (CPT code 0206U*, CPT code 0207U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of other multianalyte assays (CPT code 0412U*, CPT code 0503U*, CPT code 0568U*, CPT code 0596U) for Alzheimer's disease or dementia IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Gene expression profiling to predict development of Alzheimer's disease (CPT code 0289U**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Antinuclear antibody testing (ANA) (CPT code 86038, CPT code 86039) IS REIMBURSABLE up to three times per lifetime for the following conditions or symptoms:

Testing for rheumatoid factor (CPT code 86430, CPT code 86431) and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (CPT code 86200) IS REIMBURSABLE up to three times per lifetime for the following conditions or symptoms:

Testing of double stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (dsDNA) (CPT code 86225, CPT code 0039U) IS REIMBURSABLE up to four times per year for the following conditions or symptoms:

For a wellness visit or a general encounter without abnormal findings, antinuclear antibodies (ANA) (CPT code 86038, CPT code 86039) or extractable nuclear antigen (ENA) (CPT code 86235) testing IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of cell-bound complement activation products, for example, Avise® Lupus (CPT code 0312U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Any other serum biomarker panel testing, with or without proprietary algorithms or index scores, designed to diagnose, prognose, or monitor systemic lupus erythematosus or connective tissue diseases (CPT code 0062U, CPT code 0446U*, CPT code 0447U*, CPT code 0522U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Quantitative measurement of cardiac troponin T or I (CPT code 84484) for the diagnosis of myocardial infarction (MI) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals presenting with any of the following:

Pain in the upper abdomen, shoulders, upper arms, forearms, wrists, fingers, neck and throat, lower jaw and teeth or back pain

Shortness of breath, belching, nausea, indigestion, vomiting, diaphoresis, dizziness, lightheadedness, clamminess or fatigue

Squeezing, tightness, pressure, constriction, crushing, strangling, burning, heartburn, fullness in the chest, band-like sensation, knot in the center of the chest, lump in throat, ache, heavy weight on chest or toothache when there is radiation to the lower jaw

A maximum of four serial quantitative troponin tests (CPT code 84484) IS REIMBURSABLE in the first three days after presentation.

Testing for natriuretic peptide, such as B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) or N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide (NT- proBNP) (CPT code 83880*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals presenting with dyspnea or shortness of breath.

Testing for BNP or NT-proBNP (CPT code 83880*) IS REIMBURSABLE every rolling 12 months for individuals presenting with any of the following:

Chronic heart failure: systolic, diastolic or combined systolic and diastolic

Measurement of the following cardiac biomarkers for the diagnosis or prognosis of MI IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in conjunction with the measurement of cardiac troponin T or I:

Cardiac creatine kinase isoenzyme myocardial band (CK-MB) (CPT code 82553, CPT code 82554)

For individuals with signs and symptoms of acute coronary syndrome, quantitative measurement of cardiac troponin T or I (CPT code 84484) by an independent laboratory IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

In the outpatient setting, qualitative measurement of cardiac troponin T or I (CPT code 84512) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

In the outpatient setting, testing of growth stimulation expressed gene 2 (ST2) or its isoforms (CPT code 83006) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals diagnosed with osteoporosis, measurement of each of the following bone turnover markers IS REIMBURSABLE at a frequency of one test every three months:

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of apolipoprotein B (Apo B) (CPT code 82172**) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following:

Disorder of galactose, lipoprotein, or amino acid transport metabolism

Once per lifetime measurement of lipoprotein (a) [Lp(a)] (CPT code 83695**) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals 18 years of age or older.

Measurement of homocysteine (CPT code 83090****) or conventional measurement of C-reactive protein (CPT code 86140) as a part of a risk assessment for cardiovascular disease (CVD) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Measurement of novel lipid and non-lipid biomarkers (CPT code 82610*, CPT code 83700**, CPT code 83701**, CPT code 83704**, CPT code 83719**, CPT code 83880***, CPT code 85384, CPT code 85415) as a part of a risk assessment for CVD IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Direct measurement of small dense low-density lipoprotein (LDL) (CPT code 83722) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE except in diagnoses of Cushings syndrome, chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstruction of the bile duct or pregnancy.

CVD risk panels consisting of multiple individual biomarkers intended to assess CVD (CPT code 0052U, CPT code 0308U**, CPT code 0309U**, CPT code 0415U**, CPT code 0541U**) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Measurement of lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 (Lp-PLA2) (CPT code 83698****) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

All other biomarker panels designed to detect CVD risk (CPT code 0019M**, CPT code 0377U) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals with a diagnosis of either type 1 or type 2 diabetes, measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE once every three months.

For individuals with a diagnosis of prediabetes, annual screening for type 2 diabetes with a measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE.

Screening for prediabetes or type 2 diabetes with a measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 3 years in individuals 18 years of age and older with any of the following:

High-risk race/ethnicity (e.g., African American, Latino or Hispanic, Native American, Asian American or Pacific Islander) at risk for type 2 diabetes (e.g., obesity)

Other clinical conditions associated with insulin resistance (e.g., acanthosis nigricans)

Screening for diabetes with an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) (CPT code 82951, CPT code 82952) or measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 3 years for children ages 10 - 17 with at least one of the following:

For individuals 10 years of age or older who have been diagnosed with cystic fibrosis (CF), screening for CF-related diabetes with an OGTT (CPT code 82951, CPT code 82952) IS REIMBURSABLE once every 365 days.

For pregnant individuals, an OGTT (CPT code 82951, CPT code 82952) IS REIMBURSABLE up to once per month during pregnancy.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

At a general wellness exam, testing for chlorinated pesticides (CPT code 82441), including dichlorodiphenyldichloroethylene (DDE) and dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), using a blood, serum, plasma, saliva, urine or stool sample IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

At a general wellness exam for individuals over the age of four, testing blood, serum, plasma, saliva, urine or stool sample IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following:

5-Hydroxyindolacetic acid (5-HIAA) (CPT code 83497)

Fat differentiation, qualitative or quantitative (CPT code 82705, CPT code 82710, CPT code 82715)

At a general wellness exam, testing blood, serum, urine, cerebrospinal fluid, fingernails, hair or stool sample IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following:

Heavy metal, qualitative or quantitative (CPT code 83015***, CPT code 83018***)

Organic acids, qualitative or quantitative (CPT code 83918, CPT code 83919, CPT code 83921)

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

The tests listed below ARE REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

Nucleic acid amplification (NAAT) or polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based identification of Gardnerella vaginalis (CPT code 87511, CPT code 87512)

NAAT or PCR-based identification (CPT code 87661) of Trichomonas vaginalis

PCR based identification of Candida (CPT code 87481, CPT code 87482)

Screening for Trichomonas (CPT code 87661) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following risk factors:

For all other situations not discussed above^, the following tests (CPT code 82120, CPT code 87481, CPT code 87511, CPT code 87512, CPT code 87661) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Direct probe deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)-based identification of Candida (CPT code 87480), Gardnerella (CPT code 87510) and Trichomonas (CPT code 87660) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Rapid identification of Trichomonas by enzyme immunoassay (CPT code 87808) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Broad molecular panels designed to concurrently test for vaginitis and various other STIs (CPT code 0330U, CPT code 0505U, CPT code 0557U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE. ^For additional allowed situations in which CPT code 87481 will approve, please see Laboratory - Onychomycosis Testing

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Testing for influenza (CPT code 87804, CPT code 87400, CPT code 87501, CPT code 87502, CPT code 87275, CPT code 87276) IS REIMBURSABLE for diagnosis of patients who present with one or more of the following:

Testing with infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay with direct optical observation (CPT code 87804) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE with another influenza test (CPT code 87400, CPT code 87501, CPT code 87502, CPT code 87275, CPT code 87276).

For all other situations not described above, testing for influenza (CPT code 87804, CPT code 87400, CPT code 87501, CPT code 87502, CPT code 87275, CPT code 87276) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Viral culture testing for influenza (CPT code 87254) with a diagnosis of influenza IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Serology testing for influenza (CPT code 86710) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals with acute hematogenous osteomyelitis, measurement of C-reactive protein (CRP) (CPT code 86140, CPT code 86141**) IS REIMBURSABLE once every two days.

Measurement of erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) (CPT code 85651*, CPT Code 85652*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions at the designated frequency: ­

­ The following signs and symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome: as needed: 

­ The following signs and symptoms of large vessel vasculitis: as needed: 

 Other specific skin findings associated with large vessel vasculitis 

Measurement of CRP (CPT code 86140, CPT code 86141**) or ESR (CPT code 85651*, CPT code 85652*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions at the designated frequency: ­

For the conditions for which CRP (CPT code 86140, CPT code 86141**) or ESR (CPT code 85651*, CPT code 85652*) testing is allowed, as outlined above, measurement of ESR IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when billed in conjunction with CRP.

For all conditions not addressed above, measurement of ESR (CPT code 85651*, CPT code 85652*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Measurement of CRP (CPT code 86140, CPT code 86141**) or ESR (CPT code 85651*, CPT code 85652*) during a general exam without abnormal findings IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Urea breath testing (CPT code 83013, CPT code 83014) or stool antigen testing (CPT code 87338) for Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection IS REIMBURSABLE, no more than one test every four weeks, for following situations:

Long term usage of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) or aspirin

Low-grade gastric mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) lymphoma

For a refractory H. pylori infection, nucleic acid-based susceptibility testing (CPT code 87513, CPT code 0008U*) IS REIMBURSABLE.

Serologic testing for H. pylori infection (CPT code 83009, CPT code 86677, CPT code 87339) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

For H. pylori infection, single-step serologic testing for H. pylori (CPT code 86318) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

For all other situations not addressed above, urea breath testing (CPT code 83013, CPT code 83014), stool antigen testing (CPT code 87338) or nucleic acid-based susceptibility testing (CPT code 87513, CPT code 0008U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Stool antigen testing (CPT code 87338) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when performed simultaneously with the urea breath test (CPT code 83013).

Urea breath testing (CPT code 83013, CPT code 83014) or stool antigen testing (CPT code 87338) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when performed simultaneously with biopsy-based testing (CPT code 88305)

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a diagnosis of either Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes once every three months.

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE once every 365 days to help in the detection and diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes in individuals aged 18 and over with any of the following:

High-risk race/ethnicity (e.g., African American, Latino or Hispanics, Native American, Asian American, Pacific Islanders) at risk for Type 2 diabetes (e.g., obesity)

Other clinical conditions associated with insulin resistance (e.g., acanthosis nigricans)

Diabetes screening with a hemoglobin A1c determination (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE once every 3 years for children aged 10-17 with at least one of the following characteristics:

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for pregnant individuals up to once per month during pregnancy.

Measurement of hemoglobin A1c (CPT code 83037) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when billed in conjunction with measurement of (CPT code 82985) fructosamine.

83037 Hemoglobin; glycosylated (A1c) by device cleared by FDA for home use

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals with a confirmed diagnosis of hepatitis B virus (HBV), testing for Immunoglobulin M antibody to hepatitis B core antigen (IgM anti-HBc) (CPT code 86705) or for HBV deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) (CPT code 87516, CPT code 87517) IS REIMBURSABLE.

Antibody testing for hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection (CPT code 86803, CPT code 86804) IS REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations:

One test every 90 days for any individual with recognized conditions or exposures in any of the following situations:

Testing for HCV genotype (CPT code 87902) IS REIMBURSABLE with a confirmed diagnosis of HCV.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of serum free testosterone based on total serum testosterone (CPT code 84403**), sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG) (CPT code 84270) or bioavailable testosterone (CPT code 84410*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions:

Testing for serum total testosterone measurements (CPT code 84403**) IS REIMBURSABLE at the designated frequency in any of the following situations:

For individuals taking enzyme inhibitors for prostate cancer: as needed

For individuals receiving testosterone replacement therapy: up to eight tests every four years

Symptomatic individuals being evaluated for polycystic ovary syndrome or functional hypothalamic amenorrhea: as needed

Measurement of serum dihydrotestosterone (CPT code 82642) IS REIMBURSABLE for diagnosing 5-alpha reductase deficiency in individuals with ambiguous genitalia, hypospadias or microphallus.

Measurement of serum estradiol (CPT code 82670, CPT code 82681) IS REIMBURSABLE for the following conditions at the designated frequency:

Testing for serum total testosterone (CPT code 84403**), free testosterone (CPT code 84402) or bioavailable testosterone (CPT code 84410*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in asymptomatic individuals or in individuals with non-specific symptoms.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For 11 to 65 years of age, antigen or antibody screening for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection (CPT code 87389) IS REIMBURSABLE.

Screening for an HIV infection with an antigen or antibody combination assay (CPT code 87389) or with a rapid antibody test (CPT code 87806) IS REIMBURSABLE for all ages when any of the following conditions are met:

About to begin or actively receiving pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)

History of previous or concurrent sexually transmitted infection (STI), hepatitis or tuberculosis

For all situations described above, HIV testing (CPT code 87389, CPT code 87806) IS REIMBURSABLE no more than one test every 90 days.

HIV genotyping or phenotyping (CPT code 87901, CPT code 87903, CPT code 87904, CPT code 87906) IS REIMBURSABLE for patients with HIV.

Drug susceptibility phenotype prediction using genotypic comparison to known genotypic or phenotypic database (CPT code 87900, CPT code 0219U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

87389 Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay technique, (eg, enzyme immunoassay [EIA], enzyme- linked immunosorbent assay [ELISA], fluorescence immunoassay [FIA], immunochemiluminometric assay [IMCA]) qualitative or semiquantitative; HIV-1 antigen(s), with HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies, single result 87806 Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay with direct optical (ie, visual) observation; HIV-1 antigen(s), with HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies 87900 Infectious agent drug susceptibility phenotype prediction using regularly updated genotypic bioinformatics

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

In vitro chemotherapy sensitivity and resistance assays (CPT code 81535**, CPT code 81536**, CPT code 0083U^, CPT code 0248U^^, CPT code 0249U*, CPT code 0285U*, CPT code 0435U^^) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

81535** Oncology (gynecologic), live tumor cell culture and chemotherapeutic response by DAPI stain and morphology, predictive algorithm reported as a drug response score; first single drug or drug combination Proprietary test: ChemoFX® Lab/manufacturer: Helomics, Corp 81536** Oncology (gynecologic), live tumor cell culture and chemotherapeutic response by DAPI stain and morphology, predictive algorithm reported as a drug response score; each additional single drug or drug combination (List separately in addition to code for primary procedure) Proprietary test: ChemoFX®

0083U^ Oncology, response to chemotherapy drugs using motility contrast tomography, fresh or frozen tissue, reported as likelihood of sensitivity or resistance to drugs or drug combinations

0248U^^ Oncology, spheroid cell culture in a 3D microenvironment, 12 drug panel, brain- or brain metastasis- response prediction for each drug

0249U* Oncology (breast), semiquantitative analysis of 32 phosphoproteins and protein analytes, includes laser capture microdissection, with algorithmic analysis and interpretative report

0285U* Oncology, disease progression and response monitoring to radiation, chemotherapy, or other systematic cancer treatments, cell-free DNA, quantitative branched chain DNA amplification, plasma, reported in ng/mL Proprietary test: RadToxTM cfDNA test

0435U^^ Oncology, chemotherapeutic drug cytotoxicity assay of cancer stem cells (CSCs), from cultured CSCs and primary tumor cells, categorical drug response reported based on cytotoxicity percentage observed, minimum of 14 drugs or drug combinations

*The payment criterion for 0249U and 0285U applies to all Medicare jurisdictions except for states awarded to CGS Administrators, LLC., Noridian Healthcare

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Serologic testing, 2-tier testing strategy using a sensitive enzyme immunoassay (EIA) or immunofluorescence assay (CPT code 86618), followed by a western immunoblot assay (CPT code 0041U, CPT code 0042U) or FDA-cleared second EIA assay (CPT code 86617), IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

Nucleic acid testing to detect Borrelia burgdorferi (CPT code 87475*, CPT code 87476*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Other testing for Borrelia burgdorferi (CPT code 0316U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

86617 Antibody; Borrelia burgdorferi (Lyme disease) confirmatory test (e.g., Western Blot or immunoblot) 86618

87475* Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Borrelia burgdorferi, direct probe technique 87476* Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Borrelia burgdorferi, amplified probe technique 0041U Borrelia burgdorferi, antibody detection of 5 recombinant protein groups, by immunoblot,

0042U Borrelia burgdorferi, antibody detection of 12 recombinant protein groups, by immunoblot, IgG

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of sweat gland nerve fiber density (CPT code 88356) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when an individual presents with symptoms of painful sensory neuropathy without history of a disorder known to predispose to painful neuropathy. For example, diabetic neuropathy, toxic neuropathy, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) neuropathy, celiac neuropathy or inherited neuropathy.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined for the Commercial Payment Policy will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals with an onychomycosis Tinea unguium infection that is resistant to anti-fungal drug therapy, nucleic acid amplification testing (NAAT) for Candida (CPT code 87480*, CPT code 87481*) IS REIMBURSABLE.

NAAT (CPT code 87149*, CPT code 87150*, CPT code 87153*, CPT code 87482*, CPT code 87798*, CPT code 87801*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions or symptoms:

- Disorders of the toenail, such as onycholysis, nail dystrophy, Beau's lines or yellowing of the nail

- Onychomycosis

For the diagnosis of onychomycosis, the use of attenuated total reflectance Fourier-transform infrared (ATR-FTIR) spectroscopy (CPT code 88749) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

For the diagnosis of onychomycosis, testing for the presence of fungal-derived sterols (CPT code 82542) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Oral screening by low-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) testing (CPT code 87623*) is NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Oral screening by gene expression profiling by ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing (CPT code 0296U**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

87623* Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Human Papillomavirus (HPV), low-risk types (eg, 6, 11, 42, 43, 44) 0296U** Oncology (oral and/or oropharyngeal cancer), gene expression profiling by RNA sequencing at least 20 molecular features (eg, human and/or microbial mRNA), saliva, algorithm reported as positive or negative for signature associated with malignancy

*The payment criterion for 87623 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Palmetto GBA; Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance

Corporation; CGS Administrators, LLC; and Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC.

**The payment criterion for 0296U applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Palmetto GBA; Wisconsin Physicians Service Insurance

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Measurement of either serum lipase (CPT code 83690) or amylase (CPT code 82150) concentration for the initial diagnosis of acute pancreatitis IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals presenting with any of the following signs and symptoms:

Measurement of either serum lipase (CPT code 83690) or amylase (CPT code 82150) concentration IS NOT REIMBURSABLE more than once per week.

Measurement of serum amylase (CPT code 82150) concentration IS NOT REIMBURSABLE when billed in conjunction with serum lipase concentration (CPT code 83690).

Measurement of either serum lipase (CPT code 83690) or amylase (CPT code 82150) concentration IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations:

For asymptomatic individuals during a general exam without abnormal findings

Measurement of serum or urine trypsin, trypsinogen or trypsinogen activation peptide (TAP) (CPT code 83519) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations:

For asymptomatic individuals during a general exam without abnormal findings

Measurement of the following biomarkers with a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis IS NOT REIMBURSABLE:

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Serum intact parathyroid (PTH) testing (CPT code 83970*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions at the designated frequency:

As needed for individuals who have:

The following signs of hypoparathyroidism:

One test per year for individuals who have been diagnosed with hyperparathyroidism but who have not undergone parathyroidectomy

One test every 12 months for individuals who have been diagnosed with stage 3 chronic kidney disease (CKD)

One test every three months for individuals who have been diagnosed with stage 4 or stage 5 CKD

One test every three months for individuals who are younger than 18 years of age and who have been diagnosed with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A or type 1B, pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism, progressive osseous heteroplasia or acrodysostosis

One test per year for individuals who are 18 years of age or older and who have been diagnosed with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A or type 1B, pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism, progressive osseous heteroplasia or acrodysostosis

The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a primary diagnosis representing a general encounter without abnormal findings:

Serum ionized calcium (CPT code 82330) or urine calcium testing (CPT code 82340)

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Serum tumor markers ARE REIMBURSABLE for the following indications:

Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP) (CPT code 84078, CPT code 84080) every 90 days for: 

B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) or N-terminal fragment of B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) (CPT code 83880*) every 90 days for: 

Beta human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-HCG) (CPT code 84703, CPT code 84704) every 60 days for: 

 Ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer or primary peritoneal cancer ­

Beta-2 microglobulin (B2M) (CPT code 82232) every 90 days for: 

Calcitonin (CALCA) expression (CPT code 82308) every 60 days for: 

 Occult primary adenocarcinoma, anaplastic or undifferentiated tumors of the head and neck 

Circulating serum kappa or lambda free light chains (CPT code 83521) every 90 days for: 

Human epididymis protein 4 (HE4) expression (CPT code 86305) every 60 days for:  Ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer or primary peritoneal cancer ­

Inhibin (INHA) expression (CPT code 86336) every 60 days for:  Ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer or primary peritoneal cancer ­

All other applications of serum tumor markers (CPT code 82107, CPT code 83950, CPT code 83951, CPT code 86316**) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE: ­

Analysis of proteomic patterns in serum (CPT code 83789) for screening and detection of cancer IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Fecal calprotectin testing (CPT code 83993) IS REIMBURSABLE when any one of the following conditions or symptoms are present:

Fecal lactoferrin measurement (CPT code 83630, CPT code 83631) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of the following serologic markers ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE in individuals with Crohn's Disease, ulcerative colitis or irritable bowel syndrome:

Antibody to Escherichia coli outer membrane porin C (anti-OmpC) (CPT code 83520)

Antibody to Pseudomonas fluorescens-associated sequence I2 (anti-I2) (CPT code 83520)

Anti-cytolethal distending toxin B (anti-CdtB) and anti-vinculin antibodies (CPT code 0176U)

Anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA) (CPT code 86036, CPT code 86037)

Perinuclear anti-neutrophilic cytoplasmic antibody (pANCA) (CPT code 86021, CPT code 86255)

The use of diagnostic algorithm-based testing (CPT code 0164U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Genetic testing for inflammatory bowel disease, including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, (CPT code 0203U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Immunoglobulin G (IgG) based food sensitivity testing (e.g., inFoods® IBS Test) (CPT code 0598U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

An interferon gamma release assay (IGRA) (CPT code 86480, CPT code 86481) and an acid fast bacilli (AFB) smear or stain (CPT code 87116) ARE REIMBURSABLE to diagnose latent tuberculosis (TB) infection for individuals at risk for infection based on clinical presentation or risk factors noted below upon screening evaluation: 

 Nonspecific reaction to cell mediated immunity measurement of gamma interferon antigen response  Nonspecific reaction to tuberculin skin test without active tuberculosis 

For individuals diagnosed with TB, nucleic acid testing for Mycobacterium (CPT code 87551, CPT code 87556, CPT code 87561) IS REIMBURSABLE.

For individuals with active tuberculosis, IGRA (CPT code 86480, CPT code 86481) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Quantitative nucleic acid testing for Mycobacterium species (CPT code 87552), M. tuberculosis (CPT code 87557) and M. avium complex (CPT code 87562) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Genotyping of Mycobacterium species (CPT code 87150, CPT code 87153) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Adenosine deaminase (ADA) (CPT code 84311) levels in cerebrospinal, pleural, peritoneal, pericardial and other fluids for the diagnosis of extrapulmonary TB IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Tests designed to detect or diagnose TB through detection of serum biomarkers (CPT code 0574U) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare Local Coverage Determinations (LCD's) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

1. To detect Babesia microti, Nucleic Acid Amplification Tests (NAAT) testing, including Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) testing,

(CPT code 87469) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms:

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of Babesiosis, the use of either an Immunoglobulin G (IgG) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) indirect

immunofluorescence antibody (IFA) assay (CPT code 86753) for Babesia IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. To detect Borrelia spp., NAAT testing, including PCR testing, (CPT code 87478), an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG)

antibodies (CPT code 86619) or detection by immunoblot of Immunoglobulin G (IgG) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibody (CPT code 0043U, CPT code 0044U) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms:

1. For individuals with a diagnosis of classical or hemorrhagic dengue fever, the hemagglutination inhibition test (CPT code 86280)

IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. To detect Anaplamsa phagocytophilum or Ehrlichia chaffeensis, NAAT testing, including PCR testing, of whole blood (CPT code

87468, CPT code 87484) or an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies (CPT code 86666) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms:

1. The use of an IFA assay for Plasmodium antibodies (CPT code 86750) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. The use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies to Rickettsia (CPT code 86757) IS REIMBURSABLE twice when at

least two weeks has passed between tests and IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms:

Ulcerative lesion with regional lymphadenopathy for Rickettsia species 364D rickettsiosis

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of typhus fever or Rickettsiosis, blood culture testing (CPT code 87040) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. The use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibodies specific to West Nile virus (CPT code 86788, CPT code 86789) IS

REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms:

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of West Nile virus infection, the use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies

specific to West Nile virus (CPT code 86789) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. NAAT testing including, PCR testing, (CPT code 87662*) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) testing (CPT code 86794*) for Zika virus IS

REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms:

1. For asymptomatic individuals, testing for Babesiosis, Borrelia, Dengue virus, Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis, Plasmodium,

Rickettsiosis, West Nile virus or Zika virus with the tests discussed above IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For a diagnosis of hyperthyroidism and a diagnosis of pregnancy or post-partum, testing for antithyroglobulin antibody (TgAb) (CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE.

For a diagnosis of hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism without a diagnosis of autoimmune thyroid disease, for example, Hashimoto disease, Graves' disease, testing for thyroid antibodies (CPT code 83519, CPT code 83520, CPT code 84445, CPT code 86376, CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE once every three years.

For thyroid cancer, testing for serum thyroglobulin TgAb (CPT code 84432) and TgAb levels (CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE.

For all other situations not described above, testing for TgAb levels (CPT code 86800), thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins (CPT code 84445) and serum thyroglobulin (CPT code 84432) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Testing for thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) (CPT code 84442), thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH) (CPT code 80438, CPT code 80439) or reverse triiodothyronine (T3) (CPT code 84482) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Testing for thyroxine (CPT code 84437) over the age of two IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

A nuclear matrix protein (NMP22) test (CPT code 86386*), a bladder tumor antigen (BTA) test (CPT code 86294*, CPT code 86316*) or a fluorescence immunocytology (e.g., ImmunoCyt/uCytTM) test (CPT code 88346, CPT code 88350) IS REIMBURSABLE for a bladder neoplasm or a personal history of bladder neoplasm.

For all other situations not described above, an NMP22 test, a BTA test or a fluorescence immunocytology test IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Urinary protein biomarker panels designed to detect, monitor or predict recurrence of bladder cancer (e.g., Oncuria® Detect, Oncuria® Monitor, Oncuria® Predict) (CPT code 0365U***, CPT code 0366U***, CPT code 0367U***) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

All other urinary biomarker panels designed to diagnose or prognose bladder cancer (CPT code 0012M**, CPT code 0013M**, CPT code 0363U**, CPT code 0420U**, CPT code 0452U**, CPT code 0465U**, CPT code 0549U**, CPT code 0613U**) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.

86294* Immunoassay for tumor antigen, qualitative or semiquantitative (e.g., bladder tumor antigen) 86316* Immunoassay for tumor antigen; other antigen, quantitative, (eg, CA 50, 72-4, 549) each 86386*

88346 Immunofluorescence, per specimen; initial single antibody stain procedure 88350 Immunofluorescence, per specimen; each additional single antibody stain procedure (List separately in addition to code for primary procedure) 0012M** Oncology (urothelial), mRNA, gene expression profiling by real-time quantitative PCR of five genes (MDK, HOXA13, CDC2 [CDK1], IGFBP5, and CXCR2), utilizing urine, algorithm reported as a risk score for having urothelial carcinoma

0013M** Oncology (urothelial), mRNA, gene expression profiling by real-time quantitative PCR of five genes (MDK, HOXA13, CDC2 [CDK1], IGFBP5, and CXCR2), utilizing urine, algorithm reported as a risk score for having recurrent urothelial carcinoma

0363U** Oncology (urothelial), mRNA, gene-expression profiling by real-time quantitative PCR of 5 genes (MDK, HOXA13, CDC2 [CDK1], IGFBP5, and CXCR2), utilizing urine, algorithm incorporates age, sex, smoking history, and macrohematuria frequency, reported as a risk score for having urothelial carcinoma

Lab/Manufacturer: Pacific Edge Diagnostics USA, Ltd, Pacific Edge Diagnostics USA, Ltd 0365U*** Oncology (bladder), 10 protein biomarkers (A1AT, ANG, APOE, CA9, IL8, MMP9, MMP10, PAI1, SDC1, and VEGFA) by immunoassays, urine, diagnostic algorithm, including patient's age, race, and gender, reported as a probability of harboring urothelial cancer

0366U*** Oncology (bladder), analysis of 10 protein biomarkers (A1AT, ANG, APOE, CA9, IL8, MMP9, MMP10, PAI1, SDC1 and VEGFA) by immunoassays, urine, algorithm reported as a probability of recurrent bladder cancer Proprietary Test: Oncuria® Monitor,

0367U*** Oncology (bladder), analysis of 10 protein biomarkers (A1AT, ANG, APOE, CA9, IL8, MMP9, MMP10, PAI1, SDC1 and VEGFA) by immunoassays, urine, diagnostic algorithm reported as a risk score for probability of rapid recurrence of recurrent or persistent cancer following transurethral resection

0420U** Oncology (urothelial), mRNA expression profiling by real-time quantitative PCR of MDK, HOXA13, CDC2, IGFBP5, and CXCR2 in combination with droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) analysis of 6 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) genes TERT and FGFR3, urine, algorithm reported as a risk score for urothelial carcinoma

Lab/Manufacturer: Pacific Edge Diagnostics USA LTD, Pacific Edge Diagnostics USA LTD 0452U** Oncology (bladder), methylated PENK DNA detection by linear target enrichment-quantitative methylation-specific real-time PCR (LTE-qMSP), urine, reported as likelihood of bladder cancer Proprietary Test: EarlyTect® Bladder Cancer Detection (EarlyTect® BCD) Lab/Manufacturer: Promis Diagnostics, Inc, Promis Diagnostics, Inc 0465U** Oncology (urothelial carcinoma), DNA, quantitative methylation-specific PCR of 2 genes (ONECUT2, VIM), algorithmic analysis reported as positive or negative

0549U** Oncology (urothelial), DNA, quantitative methylated real-time PCR of TRNA-Cys, SIM2, and NKX1-1, using urine, diagnostic algorithm reported as a probability index for bladder cancer and/or upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC)

0613U** Oncology (urothelial carcinoma), DNA methylation and mutation analysis of 6 biomarkers (TWIST1, OTX1, ONECUT2, FGFR3, HRAS, TERT promoter region), methylation-specific PCR and targeted next-generation sequencing, urine, algorithm reported as a probability index for bladder cancer and upper tract urothelial carcinoma

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Urine culture testing (CPT code 87076, CPT code 87077, CPT code 87140, CPT code 87147, CPT code 87149*, CPT code 87181, CPT code 87186) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a primary diagnosis representing a general encounter without abnormal findings or similar examination.

87076 Culture, bacterial; anaerobic isolate, additional methods required for definitive identification, each isolate 87077 Culture, bacterial; aerobic isolate, additional methods required for definitive identification, each isolate 87140

87147 Culture, typing; immunologic method, other than immunofluorescence (eg, agglutination grouping), per antiserum 87149* Culture, typing; identification by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) probe, direct probe technique, per culture or isolate, each organism probed 87181 Susceptibility studies, antimicrobial agent; agar dilution method, per agent (eg, antibiotic gradient strip) 87186 Susceptibility studies, antimicrobial agent; microdilution or agar dilution (minimum inhibitory concentration [MIC] or breakpoint), each multi-antimicrobial, per plate

*The payment criterion for 87149 apply to all Medicare jurisdictions, except for CGS Administrators, LLC, Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC, Palmetto GBA, Wisconsin

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Plasma testing for protein C deficiency (CPT code 85302, CPT code 85303), protein S deficiency (CPT code 85305, CPT code 85306) and antithrombin III deficiency (CPT code 85300, CPT code 85301) IS REIMBURSABLE in any of the following situations:

Disseminated intravascular coagulation, also known as defibrination syndrome

Plasma testing for protein C deficiency (CPT code 85302, CPT code 85303) or protein S deficiency (CPT code 85305, CPT code 85306) IS REIMBURSABLE in the following situations:

Venous thrombosis risk testing (CPT codes 85300-85303, CPT code 85305, CPT code 85306) for superficial venous thrombosis, including superficial thrombophlebitis and varicosities IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The activated protein C resistance assay (CPT code 85307) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Multi-gene panel testing (CPT code 0278U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana Medicare Advantage (MA) plans recognize that a provider can charge a patient for a missed appointment, as long as the provider applies their policy according to the standards outlined in Chapter 1, Section 30.3.13 of the Medicare Claims Processing Manual. Therefore, a provider must apply any policy regarding a missed appointment equally to all patients, whether they are enrolled in the Medicare Program or not. A missed appointment fee must be the same for Medicare beneficiaries and patients who are not Medicare beneficiaries. The fee is not a charge for a health care service but compensates the provider for a missed business opportunity. A hospital may charge a patient for a missed appointment in the hospital's outpatient department only if the patient is not receiving inpatient services at the time of the missed appointment. The hospital would violate 42 CFR 489.22 if it were to charge a registered hospital inpatient a fee for missing an appointment in the hospital's outpatient department. Consistent with Original Medicare, Humana MA plans do not reimburse for a missed appointment charge imposed by a provider. A missed appointment fee should not be billed to Humana. If a provider submits a charge to Humana for a missed appointment fee, Humana will deny the charge, indicating the service is not covered under the patient's MA plan.

extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. The following applies to professional services only. Modifier 22 may be added to a procedure code to indicate that the work required to provide a service was substantially greater than is typically required. Documentation must support the substantial additional work and the reason for the additional work. Examples of circumstances that might require substantial additional work for which it is appropriate to report modifier 22 include increased intensity, time or technical difficulty of the service; increased severity of the patient's condition; and increased physical or mental effort required to provide the service. Additional service time alone does not justify the use of modifier 22. Modifier 22 should be reported only with a procedure code that has a global surgery period of 0, 10 or 90 days. Modifier 22 should not be appended to an evaluation and management (E/M) service. Humana determines additional reimbursement, if any, for a procedure code submitted with modifier 22, based on individual consideration of unusual circumstances as documented in the medical record or operative report. Humana does not allow more than the billed charge amount for a procedure code submitted with modifier 22.

extracted_content.content: Bilateral procedures are procedures that are performed on similar sites on opposite sides of the body, during the same session, by the same qualified health care practitioner. When a procedure reported using a service code with a Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (MPFS) Relative Value File (RVF) bilateral indicator 1 is performed bilaterally, providers must report the code with either modifier 50 or with anatomical modifiers such as modifiers LT and RT. Humana strongly encourages providers to report a bilateral procedure using modifier 50 rather than modifiers LT and RT, but accepts both methods. When using modifier 50 to report a bilateral procedure, report a single claim line with a unit of 1. When using modifiers LT and RT to report a bilateral procedure, report two claim lines, each with a unit of 1. Only report modifier 50 when the procedure is performed on similar but opposite sites. For example, report modifier 50 for the same service code for a procedure performed on the right and left knee. However, do not report modifier 50 for the same service code for a procedure performed on the right knee and left shoulder. When reporting two or more bilateral procedures using the same code, report the first bilateral procedure on a single claim line with a unit of 1 using modifier 50 and report a single claim line with a unit of 1 for all subsequent bilateral procedures using modifier 50 and modifier 59. It is not necessary to report modifier 50 with a service code with an MPFS RVF bilateral indicator other than 1. Special considerations for billing modifier 50 with certain anatomical modifiers Report modifier 50 in addition to eyelid, finger and toe modifiers on one claim line with a unit of 1 for procedures performed bilaterally on similar but opposite sites. Examples that are considered bilateral and should be billed with the appropriate anatomical modifiers and modifier 50:

extracted_content.content: According to the American Medical Association (AMA), "Under certain circumstances, a service or procedure is partially reduced or eliminated at the discretion of the physician or other qualified health care professional. Under these circumstances, the service provided can be identified by its usual procedure number and the addition of modifier 52, signifying that the service is reduced. This provides a means of reporting reduced services without disturbing the identification of the basic service." This policy outlines Humana's billing requirements and reimbursement for services reported with modifier 52.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Modifier 52 should be used if the procedure is partially reduced, or if the procedure is discontinued either before anesthesia is administered or if anesthesia is not planned. Humana plans allow 50 percent of the contracted rate or the base maximum amount payable under the member's plan when modifier 52 is appropriately appended to a procedure code. In certain circumstances, additional payment rules may apply. Modifier 52 is not an appropriate modifier for an evaluation and management (E/M) code or a laboratory panel code. Therefore, an E/M or a laboratory panel code is denied if billed with modifier 52.
